replicar.eyebrow: What you can replicate in your store

h2.text: Three ideas to make your CRM
h2.soft: sell instead of just filing contacts.

items.title: Qualify every lead the moment it comes in
items.line: Not every message is worth the same: some people ask out of curiosity and others have already made up their minds. When qualification happens on arrival, your team spends its time on the people who are ready to buy, and everyone else gets follow-up instead of being forgotten in an inbox. Someone asking about availability and payment options doesn't wait behind someone who just asked for the catalog.

items.title: Let the funnel move without manual data entry
items.line: When someone in sales has to move every card by hand, the CRM falls behind and stops being useful for making decisions. Define which event moves a prospect to the next stage (a reply, a quote, a payment) and let the system record it.

items.title: Watch your funnel in real time
items.line: A month-end report arrives too late. With the funnel in view, you know where prospects are getting stuck this week and which brand or channel is lagging, so you fix it before you lose the sale, not after.

testimonio._nota: Solo con aprobación escrita del cliente (frase, nombre, cargo y empresa). Sin ella, la sección no existe en el HTML. No usar los borradores de testimonios de v1.
